Antelog
evidenceItems.summary: Stops AI coding agents from leaking or destroying your data - AI coding agents are amazing. Until one deletes your database, or leaks your secrets. Antelog stops the disasters before they happen, and shows you everything your AI did: every command, every website, every bit of data it sent. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Free.

evidenceItems.title: Kokonut UI
evidenceItems.summary: Open-source UI components for your AI agent - Kokonut UI is a free, MIT-licensed library of 100+ React components made for coding agents. Connect through MCP in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or Codex, ask for "a tool approval card in my chat", and your agent finds the component, installs it and edits it in your repo. Every docs page is also served as Markdown for agents. This release adds 65 components and rebuilds 34, led by AI chat parts: tool calls, tool approval, diff review, citations and more.

evidenceItems.title: CodeMesh
evidenceItems.summary: Cut AI coding costs by 90% - CodeMesh helps AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf understand your code faster. Instead of reading the same files again and again, CodeMesh gives them only the code they need. This can reduce token usage and AI costs by over 90%, while making coding agents faster and more efficient. You keep using your favorite coding tool CodeMesh simply makes it smarter and cheaper.

evidenceItems.title: FreeFlow Dictation
evidenceItems.summary: On-device Mac dictation with a Claude Code voice hook - Hold ⌥, speak, release: text lands in any Mac app, transcribed on the Neural Engine. No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Connect Claude Code and answer its plans and questions by voice from a card. 14-day trial, then $99 once for 3 Macs.

Thunder
evidenceItems.summary: A blazing-fast, persistent, key-value AI workload database - Thunder is a blazing-fast, persistent, and scalable key-value database built in Rust for modern, data-intensive applications. Designed from the ground up for high throughput, low latency, and efficient resource utilization, Thunder uses a shard-per-core architecture to scale with CPU cores while minimizing contention. Unlike traditional in-memory databases, Thunder combines the performance of modern NVMe storage with intelligent memory management.

productLaunches.title: HiringNow
productLaunches.description: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else. - HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval. Every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also: resume builder and mock interviews. Free plan with 10 auto-applies.

productLaunches.title: Dex Semantics
productLaunches.description: Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors - Dex Semantics adds declarations to your analytical models, which capture row meaning, join nature, how numbers add up, and decisional assumptions. Thanks to this, Dex scores 80% on ADE-bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared to 73.3% without Dex (25% fewer tasks failed). Declarations live in your models as code, not a third-party tool. Dex then helps your agent convert declarations into your Semantic Layer of choice.
